what: An ambient drone instrument: tap a key to latch a drone, a note or a chord in your key. Three layers a voice into a big reverb with shimmer and freeze; GLINT's icy FM bells on top, by hand, arpeggio or sequence; BASS a deep line below, held or sequenced; three LFOs keep it all moving.

smk37.what: FRASIL on the SMK-37: tap a key to latch a drone, a note or a chord in your key, into a big reverb with shimmer and freeze. GLINT's icy FM bells above, BASS below, LEAD for melodies. Tested on the Elite; the Pro and MKE-P37 packages are not tested yet. Back the keyboard up first.
